Custom ticket/coupon-shaped cart glyph at the top-right of the navbar: a 27x30 viewBox SVG with scalloped (notched) edges, drawn in white on the black navbar, with the live cart-count number ('0') absolutely overlaid and centered on top of it. Deliver as a single-color transparent SVG (currentColor / fill-inheriting) so the count text stays centered and the mark stays tintable in the white-on-black scheme.

Single global typeface: Inter (imported from Google Fonts), carrying every text element across all four sections — nav links, the superscript 'Framelix 3D' lockup, the 'Cinematic Motion Studios' and 'Shipping Now' headlines (clamp 2rem->68px / 2rem->52px, medium weight), both pill CTAs ('Explore Reel', 'Buy Now'), the marquee text, and the 'Explore now' label (font-weight 450). Swap with the brand display/body sans; the clamp headline sizes and medium/450 weights are tuned to Inter's metrics.

mechanic: A pure-black multi-section landing page (white logo + 3-column nav + scalloped ticket cart navbar) stacking a full-screen unscrimmed object-cover looping hero video with framer-motion fade/slide-in headline and CTA, a lavender (#A6A4FF) infinite CSS translateX(0->-50%) 20s-linear marquee banner, and a light-gray (#EAEAEA) rounded-bottom 'Shipping Now' section centered on an 800x800 object-contain looping product video.
techDelivery: React + Tailwind CSS + TypeScript with framer-motion; Inter loaded from Google Fonts; the hero headline/CTA entrance uses framer-motion fade+slide (0.8s, with a 0.3s-delayed up-slide on the CTA) while the marquee is a pure CSS keyframe (translateX 0 to -50%, 20s linear infinite) registered in tailwind.config alongside the tailwindcss-animate plugin; rounded-full pill buttons and a 9999px global border-radius token; the cart icon is an inline scalloped SVG and the logo is an whitened via the brightness-0 invert filter.
reskinNotes: Three distinct background surfaces are baked as literal hex per section rather than a single token set: black (#000) shell, lavender #A6A4FF marquee, and light-gray #EAEAEA shipping panel (40px rounded bottom corners) — a retint means editing each section, and the marquee/shipping blocks flip to black-on-light text so a dark brand palette can invert legibility. The hero video has NO overlay scrim, so a light reel drops the white headline + white pill out. The logo relies on a CSS brightness-0 invert filter to force white, which silently breaks if the brand mark is multi-color or already white-on-transparent. The scalloped ticket/coupon cart icon is a hand-authored 27x30 inline SVG path with the count number overlaid — a different cart silhouette means redrawing the path, not swapping a token. Headline sizes are viewport clamps (2rem->68px hero, 2rem->52px shipping) at medium weight tuned to Inter, the 'Explore now' label is an unusual font-weight 450, and the shipping video uses fixed 800x800 + -my-24 negative margins, so a wider face / longer copy / non-square video reflows those blocks. All copy ('Framelix' + '3D' superscript, 'Cinematic Motion Studios', 'Ready in 24-48 hours', 'New! 3D OS V1.2.1 out now!' x6, 'Shipping Now', 'Explore Reel', 'Buy Now', 'Explore now', the nav labels Reels/Services/Projects/Pipeline/Careers/Get In Touch, and the '0' cart count) is hardcoded in the markup.
